stories.headline: Cisco Posts Record Q3 Revenue, Cuts Nearly 4,000 Jobs in AI Restructuring

key_facts.fact: Cisco reported Q3 FY26 revenue of $15.8 billion, up 12% year over year, with GAAP net income of $3.4 billion ($0.85/share, up 35%) and non-GAAP EPS of $1.06, up 10%.
key_facts.excerpt: Cisco reported third quarter revenue of $15.8 billion, net income on a generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) basis of $3.4 billion or $0.85 per share, and non-GAAP net income of $4.2 billion or $1.06 per share. Total revenue was $15.8 billion, up 12%.

key_facts.fact: Cisco announced a restructuring plan on May 13 that will reduce its workforce in Q4 by fewer than 4,000 jobs, representing less than 5% of its total employee base, with notifications beginning May 14.
key_facts.excerpt: we are making changes today that will result in the reduction of our overall workforce in Q4 by fewer than 4,000 jobs, representing less than 5 percent of our total employee base. Most notifications will begin on May 14.

key_facts.fact: Cisco expects pre-tax restructuring charges of up to $1 billion, recognizing about $450 million in Q4 fiscal 2026 and the remainder in fiscal 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: Cisco currently estimates that it will recognize pre-tax charges of up to $1 billion consisting of severance and other one-time termination benefits, and other costs. Cisco expects to recognize approximately $450 million of these charges in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026.

key_facts.fact: Cisco raised its fiscal 2026 revenue forecast to $62.8 billion-$63 billion from a prior $61.2 billion-$61.7 billion, helped by a surge in hyperscaler orders for AI infrastructure.
key_facts.excerpt: The company now expects fiscal 2026 revenue in the range of US$62.8-billion to US$63-billion, compared with its earlier forecast of US$61.2-billion to US$61.7-billion.

key_facts.fact: Cisco now expects about $9 billion in FY2026 AI orders, up from a prior estimate of $5 billion; shares rose roughly 20% in after-hours trading.
key_facts.excerpt: The layoffs, representing less than 5% of the company's global workforce, sent shares up roughly 20% in after-hours trading. The company expects to generate about $9 billion in FY2026 AI orders, up from a prior estimate of $5 billion.

stories.headline: LinkedIn to Cut About 5% of Staff in Latest Tech-Sector Layoffs

key_facts.fact: LinkedIn planned to inform staff of layoffs on May 13, cutting about 5% of its more than 17,500 full-time workers as it reorganizes teams toward growing business areas.
key_facts.excerpt: The Microsoft-owned social network plans to cut about five per cent of its headcount as it reorganizes teams and focuses personnel on areas where its business is growing. LinkedIn employs more than 17,500 full-time workers globally.

key_facts.fact: CEO Daniel Shapero told employees in a memo the reductions would impact engineering, product, marketing and the Global Business Organization, and that LinkedIn is scaling back marketing campaigns, vendor spend and underutilized office space.
key_facts.excerpt: LinkedIn is 'scaling back investments in some areas including marketing campaigns, vendor spend, customer events and underutilized office space'... It states that LinkedIn is laying off workers across its Global Business Organization, marketing, engineering and product teams.

key_facts.fact: The company is closing an office in Graz, Austria as part of the reorganization.
key_facts.excerpt: The company is said to be closing an office in Graz, Austria, as part of the reorganization.

key_facts.fact: Sources said the layoffs were not driven by AI replacing jobs, though they come as US employers cited AI as the top reason for cuts for a second straight month.
key_facts.excerpt: The layoffs are not because LinkedIn is looking to replace human workers with artificial intelligence, the sources said. In April, employers announced 83,387 layoffs... Artificial intelligence caused 26 percent of those layoffs, making it the most frequently cited reason for workforce reductions for a second month.

key_facts.fact: LinkedIn's revenue rose 12% in the just-ended quarter from a year prior, according to parent Microsoft's securities filings.
key_facts.excerpt: The cuts come as revenue at LinkedIn, which sells recruiting tools and subscriptions, rose 12% in the just-ended quarter from a year prior.

stories.headline: Cerebras Prices IPO at $185 a Share, Raising $5.55B in Year's Largest Debut

key_facts.fact: Cerebras Systems priced its US IPO at $185 per share on May 13, above the marketed $150-$160 range, selling 30 million shares to raise $5.55 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Cerebras Systems priced its U.S. initial public offering at $185 per share on Wednesday, above the top end of its indicated price range... The IPO raised $5.55 billion for Cerebras, based on 30 million shares sold.

key_facts.fact: The pricing implies a fully diluted valuation of $56.43 billion, making it the largest stock market debut so far in 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: It implies a valuation on Cerebras on a fully diluted basis of $56.43 billion, making it the largest stock market debut so far this year.

key_facts.fact: The offering was heavily oversubscribed, with investors placing orders for more than 20 times the shares available; Cerebras had raised its range from an earlier $115-$125 and upsized from 28 million shares.
key_facts.excerpt: The company previously upsized the highly anticipated IPO... after investors placed orders for more than 20 times the number of shares available. The company marketed the offering at between $150 and $160 per share, up from an earlier range of $115 to $125 per share.

key_facts.fact: Shares are expected to begin trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market on May 14 under the ticker 'CBRS', with the offering set to close May 15; underwriters also have a 30-day option for up to 4.5 million additional shares.
key_facts.excerpt: Cerebras has granted the underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional 4,500,000 shares... The shares are expected to begin trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market on May 14, 2026, under the ticker symbol 'CBRS.' The offering is expected to close on May 15, 2026.

stories.headline: US Clears Nvidia H200 Sales to ~10 Chinese Firms, but No Deliveries Yet

key_facts.fact: The US Commerce Department has approved around 10 Chinese companies, including Alibaba, Tencent, ByteDance and JD.com, to buy Nvidia's H200 AI chips, plus distributors including Lenovo and Foxconn.
key_facts.excerpt: The U.S. Commerce Department has approved around 10 Chinese companies including Alibaba, Tencent, ByteDance and JD.com to purchase Nvidia's H200 chips... A handful of distributors including Lenovo and Foxconn have also been approved.

key_facts.fact: Each approved customer can purchase up to 75,000 chips under the US licensing terms, buying directly from Nvidia or through intermediaries.
key_facts.excerpt: Buyers are permitted to purchase either directly from Nvidia or through those intermediaries and each approved customer can purchase up to 75,000 chips under the U.S. licensing terms.

key_facts.fact: Not a single delivery has been made; Chinese firms pulled back after guidance from Beijing as the government prioritizes a self-sufficient domestic chip industry.
key_facts.excerpt: The U.S. has cleared around 10 Chinese firms to buy Nvidia's second-most powerful AI chip, the H200, but not a single delivery has been made so far... Despite U.S. approval, deals have stalled, as Chinese firms pulled back after guidance from Beijing.

key_facts.fact: Under an arrangement negotiated by Trump, the US would receive 25% of revenue from the chip sales, a structure requiring the chips to pass through US territory before shipment to China.
key_facts.excerpt: Trump negotiated an arrangement under which the U.S. would receive 25% of the revenue from the chip sales — a structure that requires the chips to pass through U.S. territory before being shipped to China.

key_facts.fact: US rules issued in January require Chinese buyers to demonstrate they have installed sufficient security procedures and would not use the chips for military purposes.
key_facts.excerpt: The US Department of Commerce has granted licenses to major entities such as ByteDance, JD.com, and distributors including Lenovo and Foxconn. Under the current licensing terms, each approved customer is permitted to acquire up to 75,000 units.

stories.headline: FDA Approves Two First-in-Class Cancer Therapies, Beqalzi and Inqovi-Venetoclax Combo

key_facts.fact: The FDA granted accelerated approval to BeOne Medicines' Beqalzi (sonrotoclax), the first BCL2 inhibitor for adults with relapsed or refractory mantle cell lymphoma after at least two lines of therapy including a BTK inhibitor.
key_facts.excerpt: the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has granted accelerated approval to BEQALZI (sonrotoclax), a foundational, next-generation BCL2 inhibitor, for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory (R/R) mantle cell lymphoma (MCL), after at least two lines of systemic therapy, including a Bruton's tyrosine kinase (BTK) inhibitor.

key_facts.fact: Beqalzi's approval was supported by a Phase 1/2 study showing a 52% overall response rate, a 16% complete response rate, and a median duration of response of 15.8 months.
key_facts.excerpt: Overall response rate (ORR): 52% (95% CI, 42-62); Complete response (CR) rate: 16% (95% CI, 9.1-24.0); Median duration of response (DOR): 15.8 months.

key_facts.fact: Beqalzi is the 14th novel drug approval of 2026, per the FDA's Novel Drug Approvals list, approved 5/13/2026.
key_facts.excerpt: 14. Beqalzi | sonrotoclax | 5/13/2026 | To treat adults with relapsed or refractory mantle cell lymphoma after at least two lines of systemic therapy, including a Bruton's tyrosine kinase inhibitor.

key_facts.fact: Separately on May 13, the FDA approved Taiho Oncology's Inqovi (decitabine and cedazuridine) plus venetoclax, the first all-oral combination regimen for newly diagnosed acute myeloid leukemia in patients 75 or older or ineligible for intensive chemotherapy.
key_facts.excerpt: the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved INQOVI (decitabine and cedazuridine) plus venetoclax as a treatment for adults with newly diagnosed acute myeloid leukemia (AML) who are 75 years or older or who are ineligible for intensive induction chemotherapy. INQOVI in combination with venetoclax is the first and only all-oral combination treatment regimen approved for this patient population.

key_facts.fact: In the supporting trial, the Inqovi-venetoclax combination produced a 41.6% complete remission rate and a median overall survival of 15.5 months.
key_facts.excerpt: Among efficacy-evaluable patients, 42 achieved a CR (41.6%; 95% CI, 31.9-51.8)... Median overall survival was 15.5 months—outcomes that compare favorably with the parenteral azacitidine plus venetoclax regimen from VIALE-A.

stories.headline: Russian Parliament Passes Bill Allowing Putin to Order Invasions of Foreign Countries

key_facts.fact: Russia's parliament approved a bill on May 13 that allows President Vladimir Putin to order the invasion of foreign countries.
key_facts.excerpt: Russia's parliament approved a bill on Wednesday that allows President Vladimir Putin to order the invasion of foreign countries.

key_facts.fact: The bill legally permits Moscow to send troops abroad to protect Russian citizens who are arrested, investigated, put on trial or abused by foreign states, international courts and organizations Russia doesn't belong to.
key_facts.excerpt: Moscow will be legally allowed to send troops abroad to protect Russian citizens who are arrested, investigated, put on trial or abused in any way by foreign states, international courts and organizations that Russia doesn't belong to.

key_facts.fact: Putin has 14 days to sign the bill into law.
key_facts.excerpt: Putin has 14 days to sign the bill into law.

key_facts.fact: Ukraine criticized the measure, with a foreign ministry spokesman saying the State Duma had decided to act as a 'factory for legalizing political adventures, occupation and terror.'
key_facts.excerpt: the Duma's new bill was seen in Kyiv as confirming the 'further militarization of Russian policy'... 'The current composition of the State Duma of the Russian Federation has decided to go down in history as a factory for legalizing political adventures, occupation and terror.'

stories.headline: Blackstone's New Data Center REIT Raises $1.75B in NYSE IPO

key_facts.fact: Blackstone Digital Infrastructure Trust priced its IPO of 87.5 million shares at $20 per share on May 13, raising $1.75 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Blackstone Digital Infrastructure Trust Inc. (NYSE: BXDC) today announced the pricing of its initial public offering of 87.5 million shares of its common stock at a price to the public of $20.00 per share.

key_facts.fact: The data center REIT will trade on the NYSE under the ticker 'BXDC' beginning May 14, with the offering expected to close May 15; if the underwriters' 30-day option is exercised in full, gross proceeds reach $2.0 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: If the option to purchase additional shares is exercised in full, the gross proceeds of the offering will be $2.0 billion... The shares are expected to begin trading on the New York Stock Exchange on May 14, 2026 under the ticker symbol 'BXDC.' The offering is expected to close on May 15, 2026.

key_facts.fact: The vehicle will invest proceeds primarily in newly-constructed, income-generating, stabilized data center assets leased to investment-grade hyperscale tenants on long-term contracts.
key_facts.excerpt: The Company intends to invest the net proceeds from the offering primarily in newly-constructed, income-generating, stabilized data center assets in accordance with the Company's investment strategy.

key_facts.fact: The REIT targets data center acquisitions valued between $250 million and $1.5 billion and anticipates returns of 5.75% to 7% or higher; a Blackstone affiliate indicated interest in buying up to $200 million of shares.
key_facts.excerpt: The IPO will fund the REIT's acquisition of newly constructed data centers, occupied by 'top investment-grade hyperscalers,' valued between $250M and $1.5B. The firm anticipates returns of between 5.75% and 7% or higher... an affiliated Blackstone entity has indicated interest in purchasing up to $200M of shares.

key_facts.fact: Blackstone's filing cites the total US market for stabilized data center assets growing from $175 billion in 2023 to $275 billion in 2025, with an estimated $1 trillion addressable market over the next five years.
key_facts.excerpt: The total market value of stabilized data center assets in the U.S. has grown from $175B in 2023 to $275B in 2025, according to Blackstone's filing. By 2030, that figure is expected to more than triple to $1T.
